attributes.name: banner_band_color_treatment
attributes.definition: The background color treatment of a full-width horizontal band/strip embedded in the page, relative to surrounding page.

values.definition: Band uses a solid mid-gray/medium-tone fill distinct from the page.
A light-colored band contrasts against a dark surrounding page.
Band blends with the page background.

attributes.name: band_content_type
attributes.definition: What primary content the full-width band holds.

values.definition: Band holds a call-to-action with text and button, e.g. alert signup.
Band holds a row of logos (clients, partners, press).

attributes.name: cta_button_style_in_band
attributes.definition: Color treatment of the button inside a banded strip.

values.definition: Inverted white-filled button with accent-colored label.
